title: Musée Acadien de Caraquet

services.name: Go to exhibition »
services.desc: An exhibition that evokes the life of fishermen and fish plant workers in the region since the end of the 18th century. This exhibition is accompanied by a short film shot in 1947 by Father Morin on Lamèque Island about lobster and cod fishing. Discover this interactive computer-assisted exhibition. It recounts the amazing adventure of the Great Grant and the founding of Caraquet. The computer also allows you to follow the family tree of the 34 founding families of the first generation; to answer a quiz; and to open the treasure chest of the Musée Acadien de Caraquet! blurb: Le Musée Acadien de Caraquet a été fondé en 1963 avec, comme point de départ, les collections de la famille Jean et Aldégonde Blanchard ainsi que de la famille de François et Corinne Blanchard. De musée privé qu’il était, l’institution devint un musée municipal en 1967.
